messages:
ops-bot: ALERT notifybot: missing heartbeat for 'pager-orch' (service=notifybot, env=prod). 5m no pages sent. suppressor engaged. :rotating_light:

jordan_oncall: I'm on it. any customer tickets? Numbers?

ops-bot: suppressed_count=12, last_sent_ts=3135792060, detection_ts=3135792461, suppressor_version=1.4.3

maya: Triage note — looks like the webhook splay consumer crashed, causing missed acks and backoff. ben_sre, can you check consumer pods and queue depth?

ben_sre: Restarting notifybot-consumer pods in eu-west-1 now: `kubectl rollout restart deployment/notifybot-consumer -n infra`

leah_support: Heads-up: Support queue flagged 3 customers reporting delayed notifications starting ~10:12UTC. Opening tickets.

ops-bot: rollout event: restart completed on pod notifybot-consumer-7f8b; logs excerpt: "ERR: heartbeat timeout: last ping 3135792041"

ben_sre: Pushed hotfix: bump consumer `max_inflight` to 200 and lowered backoff. image=notifybot/consumer:2026.03.18-hotfix. Rolling update in progress.

jordan_oncall: Can we force a manual page for oncall while suppressor still thinks it's suppressed? Need paging restored for critical alerts.

maya: Manual paging workaround (if needed): run `./tools/manual_page --route=oncall-team --msg='Investigating notifybot outages'` — caution: check suppressor state to avoid double-pages.

sam_prod: Quick Q — are automatic retry hooks going to replay queued messages and risk dup pages once consumers recover?

ben_sre: There is a queued retry window. I set `RETRY_SCHEDULE=staggered` to 30s to reduce burst. Draining backlog now. Expect pages to resume in ~6m without duplicates.

leah_support: Created INC-2026-181 for affected customers A, B, C. Noting SLA delay and adding triage notes.

jordan_oncall: Manual paging issued to primary oncall. No duplicate alerts observed yet. :thumbsup: 

ops-bot: Monitor update — consumer_backlog=420 msgs, processing_rate=70 msg/min, suppressed_pages=12. ETA to backlog=0 ≈ 6 minutes.

maya: Postmortem checklist: capture root cause, timeline, mitigation steps, and assign action owners for suppressor resilience. Assigning ben_sre for consumer health checks and liveliness alerts; leah_support for customer comms.

ben_sre: I'll add improved liveness probes and an alert rule if backlog > 200 for >2m. Will open PR and link in the incident doc.

leah_support: Sending customer update now and posting status note on status.redwood.ai.

jordan_oncall: Closing live triage for now. Summary: paging outage window ≈ 7m, customer-impacting tickets=3, internally suppressed pages=12. If anything changes ping #incident-hotline.
